name: Team Picker
description: Add who's playing, mark who came today and split them into fair teams by skill with one tap.
prompt: A team maker: save your list of players, tick who is here today, give each one 1 to 3 stars, choose 2 to 6 teams and get balanced teams with an animated reveal, then share them.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Añade a quién juega, marca quién ha venido hoy y haz equipos igualados por nivel con un toque.
